create.name: Buddhist Society of Victoria
create.bio:
The Buddhist Society of Victoria (BSV), set up in 1953, describes itself as the oldest Buddhist organisation in the state. It follows the Theravada tradition while welcoming teachers from other Buddhist schools, and Ajahn Brahm serves as its spiritual adviser. Its city base, the Buddhaloka Centre in Malvern East in Melbourne's south-east, hosts monks, nuns and lay teachers who lead meditation evenings and Dhamma talks without charge.

In 2015 the society opened Newbury Buddhist Monastery, a forest monastery for both monks and nuns in the countryside a little over an hour from central Melbourne. Beside it stands the Sanctuary of Stillness, a residential centre where lay people join silent five-day retreats with walking and sitting practice, a daily talk and time for questions. The weekly round includes a Sunday Dhamma talk followed by a shared lunch, a Monday guided sit with a resident monastic, a Tuesday class with a lay teacher, a children's Dhamma school, a teens group and a monthly community sit at the monastery. Sunday talks and Monday meditations are streamed live on the society's YouTube channel, which has kept recordings since 2014, and the talks are also released as a podcast.

courses.title: Relax & Grow: 5 Day Retreat with Bhante Cunda and Bhante Bodhidhaja
courses.description: A silent residential retreat at the Sanctuary of Stillness beside Newbury Buddhist Monastery, led by two monks trained under Ajahn Brahm. Days alternate walking and sitting meditation, with a talk and question time each day; attendance is for the whole retreat.
courses.price: Room bond: BSV Member $400 (single room) / $300 (twin-share); Non-Member $480 / $380

courses.title: 5 Day Retreat with Ajahn Sadaro
courses.description: Ajahn Sadaro, who lives at the society's Buddhaloka vihara, leads a silent five-day retreat of walking and sitting practice at Newbury with a daily talk and questions. Those who cannot travel may join the sessions on Zoom for a donation.
courses.price: Room bond: BSV Member $410 (single room) / $310 (twin-share); Non-Member $490 / $390; online attendance by donation

courses.title: 5 Day Retreat with Ajahn Mudito
courses.description: A silent residential retreat at the Sanctuary of Stillness with Ajahn Mudito, a monk of Bodhinyana Monastery who helped build up the Newbury community. The programme follows a set sequence of meditation sessions and talks, so places are for the full five days.
courses.price: Room bond: BSV Member $400 (single room) / $300 (twin-share); Non-Member $480 / $380

courses.title: BSV membership
courses.description: Annual or lifetime membership of the society. Members get reduced rates and earlier booking on its residential retreats, can borrow from its library and receive the newsletter.
courses.price: Standard $ 80 / annually; Concession $ 40 / annually; Lifetime $ 1200 / One-time-fee

free_resources.title: Weeknight guided meditations
free_resources.description: Recordings of the Monday evening guided sits led by the society's monastics, gathered from its live streams, along with an audio version.

free_resources.title: Dhamma Talks podcast
free_resources.description: The society's free podcast of talks by visiting and resident monks and nuns, sorted into talks, meditations and retreat recordings.

free_resources.title: Discover Buddhism
free_resources.description: Introductory Friday-night teachings on Buddhist basics and meditation with Ajahn Sadaro, plus short online group sits for beginners on weeknights via the society's Discord community.
